summary: Full regression on the new Weather Integration feature (backend + frontend) plus optimistic-concurrency (version) PATCH regression and light dashboard/leads smoke. 13/13 pytest passed. Frontend Playwright verified Site Detail weather card (26°C, 7-day forecast, impact badge, data status), location_label format '[Site Name] — [City], [State]', Performance Analytics Weather Correlation panel, Assets page WeatherChip (500 chips available, 0 N/A), and Demo Leads page still renders. No console errors.

minor.issue: Site documents that have never been PATCHed do not include a 'version' field in the response (defaults are only applied via $ifNull inside the PATCH pipeline). Frontend must therefore treat missing site.version as 1 when composing PATCH bodies. Assets DO include version. Consider projecting a default version:1 in GET responses for consistency.

action_items: (Optional) Project 'version' with default 1 in GET /api/fleet/sites/{id} response so clients don't need to fall back — matches asset shape.
(Optional) Add data-testid attributes to /contact form inputs (carried over from prior iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/weather.py get_weather() gracefully returns dict on all failure paths — good. CACHE_TTL_MINUTES=20 within the 15-30min window. `httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=8)` is reasonable.

fleet.py /weather/batch caps at 20 site_ids — matches request contract. Serial awaits inside for-loop; acceptable because cache hits are cheap, but on cold cache 20 upstream calls will be sequential (~could take up to ~8s * N in worst case). Consider asyncio.gather for cold-cache batches if perf becomes an issue.

fleet_admin.py PATCH uses `$ifNull: ['$version', 1]` for optimistic concurrency — correct. Return code is 409 on version mismatch (verified via test). Tests confirmed version bumps by exactly 1 on success and rejects stale versions.
WeatherSummaryCard.jsx correctly handles unavailable/cached/live/stale states via data-testid='weather-data-status'.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing site S00001 and its assets; PATCH bumps site S00001 version by 1 (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Weather integration verified live (WeatherAPI.com key configured). Backend endpoints: /api/fleet/sites/{id}/weather, /assets/{id}/weather (inheritance), /weather/batch (up to 20), /weather/correlation (points array with all 7 expected keys). Frontend routes to remember: site detail is '/site/:site_id' NOT '/sites/:id'. WeatherChip on Assets page uses batched endpoint. Workspace still in demo mode as requested.
